features_carry_signal.note: Not information-identical to the ranker statistic (V_E pass) and above chance on 11,340 labeled pairs (V_C pass).

the_anomaly.reading: A label-SHUFFLED control scored 2.6x the real arm and near the oracle 0.1142. A control that beats its treatment indicates the FIT is the defect, not the features. Label permutation preserves class balance, so a near-random fit can still load on the single strongest feature.

question: Does a standardised, regularised fit convert the pair-level signal into top-1 accuracy, and does it then beat BOTH controls?

protocol_frozen.val_test_split: Held-out QUERIES split half/half into VAL and TEST, seeded PIN+1. The operating lambda is selected on VAL and reported on TEST. Selecting on TEST is the defect retracted earlier this turn; it is not repeated.
protocol_frozen.standardisation: Features z-scored with TRAIN column means and stds, applied identically to VAL and TEST.
protocol_frozen.shuffled_control: refitted at the SAME lambda as the real arm
protocol_frozen.random_control: uniform pick among the top-5, seeded PIN

frozen_rule.selector_must_discriminate: max(val) - min(val) > 0.005, else NO_INFORMATION and the selection is void
